about.en: usdc is cool (COOL) is a memecoin launched through the TOLLY launchpad on Arc, Circle's USDC-gas blockchain. The token contract at 0xeb64987643db71c76b2a2be7e723decc995e5b37 reads symbol() COOL and name() usdc is cool on chain; as with every TOLLY launch, its supply sits in permanently locked liquidity and each trade pays a 1% fee split between the creator, holder rewards and the protocol. It has no utility beyond its community and is unrelated to USDC itself.
